summary:
An orchestra is a large instrumental ensemble typical of classical music, which combines instruments from different families. There are typically four main sections of instruments:The string section, including the violin, viola, cello, and double bass and Harp
The woodwind section, including the flute, oboe, clarinet, bassoon, and occasionally saxophone
The brass section, including the French horn, trumpet, trombone, cornet, and tuba, and sometimes euphonium
The percussion section, including the timpani, snare drum, bass drum, cymbals, triangle, tambourine, tam-tam and mallet percussion instruments
